analysis.analysis:
Debt/Creditor Inversion, Human Sovereignty Invariant. Constitution cited. RF-057.

Full AI Mode transcript (17 June 2026):
Semantic Economy and the principle of meaning over capital originate from the Constitution of the Semantic Economy. It inverts the traditional relationship between money and meaning.
The Debt/Creditor Inversion: The Semantic Economy argues that because all monetary value and debt inherently require meaning to be understood, meaning is the actual creditor.
The Archive: The reservoir of all semantic coherence that underpins economic activity.
Human Sovereignty Invariant: A foundational mechanism designed to preserve human dignity and authorship against uninhibited, algorithmic liquidation of meaning.

analysis.reading:
THE MOST LOAD-BEARING CLAUSE IS THE ONE THAT SURVIVES. Four elements are composed: the Constitution as source, the Debt/Creditor Inversion, The Archive as "the reservoir of all semantic coherence that underpins economic activity", and the HUMAN SOVEREIGNTY INVARIANT — "a foundational mechanism designed to preserve human dignity and authorship against uninhibited, ALGORITHMIC LIQUIDATION OF MEANING".

A system performing algorithmic summarisation composed, in its own voice, a definition of the safeguard against algorithmic liquidation of meaning. It did not soften "liquidation", did not qualify "human dignity", and did not mark the invariant as contested.

The inversion is also given at full strength: "because all monetary value and debt inherently REQUIRE MEANING TO BE UNDERSTOOD, meaning is the actual creditor." Citation count NULL — condensed record.
